intelligence.human_view: A Naya Note is the answer to "what did he mean by that, in one beautiful thing I can keep?" — not a transcript, but the essence: what it is saying, the intelligence in it, the value of it, put in a beautiful format. And then it is kept properly — noted, saved, dated, timed, organized — in the Smart Vault, where it can be remembered, and shared in NayaNET, where it can travel. That is what the note is FOR: memory and sharing, not storage. And it happens on the fly, in the moment — "smart note this" — in the intelligent block format, with images or without, beautiful either way, because the format carries it. Then the block itself: he looked at the bottom of it and saw the flattest part — flat pills and little stars under boards that are real objects. Warmer does not mean more words or more controls; it means the light comes from the objects themselves. More luxurious means fewer, better controls, each with real depth — the heart as a real jewel you can press, the stars as real gold, the counts carried on the objects the way the digit tiles carry numbers. And the watch-out is the whole discipline: the bottom is the part people touch most — love, like, share, add intel — so it must stay push-button simple. Warmth from depth and glow, never from adding things. The boards do not change; the bottom rises to meet them.
intelligence.simple_view: A Naya Note is like catching a firefly in a beautiful jar! You take what someone said, you keep just the sparkly, important part — what it means and why it's special — and you put it in a beautiful jar so you can remember it and share it with your friends! You can do it super fast — just say "smart note this!" — and sometimes there's a picture in the jar, sometimes not, and it's beautiful either way! And the bottom of the jar — the little hearts and stars — those should be shiny and warm and beautiful too, like real jewels!
intelligence.grandma_view: A Naya Note, love, is like catching a firefly in a beautiful jar! You take what someone said, you keep just the sparkly, important part — what it means and why it's special — and you put it in a beautiful jar so you can remember it and share it with your friends! You can do it super fast, dear — just say "smart note this!" — and sometimes there's a picture in the jar, sometimes not, and it's beautiful either way! And the bottom of the jar — the little hearts and stars — those should be shiny and warm and beautiful too, like real jewels!
intelligence.naya_view: DISTILL THIS INTO ITS ESSENCE — WHAT IT'S SAYING, THE INTELLIGENCE, THE VALUE — AND PUT IT IN A BEAUTIFUL FORMAT SO IT CAN BE REMEMBERED, STORED IN THE SMART VAULT, AND SHARED IN NAYANET. NOTED AND SAVED AND DATED AND TIMED AND ORGANIZED. ON THE FLY: "SMART NOTE THIS" AND IT'S SMART-NOTED IN AN INTELLIGENT BLOCK FORMAT; IMAGES SOMETIMES, SOMETIMES NOT — BEAUTIFUL EITHER WAY. THE BLOCK BOTTOM: WARMER, MORE ELEGANT, MORE LUXURIOUS — THE FIVE STARS COULD BE BETTER, THE HEARTS AND THE LOVES COULD BE BETTER. WARMTH FROM DEPTH AND GLOW, NEVER FROM ADDING THINGS. THE BOARDS THEMSELVES DO NOT CHANGE — THE BOTTOM RISES TO MEET THEM.
